seo.title: Loire Valley holiday ideas and itineraries
seo.description: Plan a weekend, three days or a week among Loire castles, vineyards, walking routes and relaxing garden moments.

hero.title: A stay to shape, never a schedule to fill.
hero.description: From a spontaneous weekend to a longer holiday, choose your pace and let the Loire Valley do the rest.
hero.imageCaption: The Loire Valley through the seasons

intro.title: See a great deal, or just enough.
intro.text: These suggestions offer direction rather than a timetable. Always leave space for a long meal, a nap beneath the trees or a discovery made along the way.

stays.title: A weekend to slow down
stays.lead: Two days to leave everyday life behind without trying to fit in everything.
steps: Arrive gently, stroll through the village and dine at home.
Walk to Cheverny in the morning, then enjoy the garden and an evening drink.
Visit a market, linger over breakfast and head home without rushing.
stays.imageAlt: Welcoming living room at the house

stays.title: Heritage, vineyards and garden
stays.lead: An ideal balance between celebrated Loire sights and slower moments.
steps: Walk to Cheverny for the interiors and gardens.
Reach Chambord by bike or car and leave time for the park.
Explore Blois, taste Cheverny wines and spend a final evening in the courtyard.
stays.imageAlt: Loire Valley castle in its park

stays.title: A week with a little of everything
stays.lead: Memorable outings, slow days and enough time for everyone to find their rhythm.
steps: Choose two castles: Cheverny and Chambord or Blois.
Plan a family day at Beauval, a swimming spot or a canoe route.
Add cycling, Sologne paths and two afternoons with no plans at all.

stays.title: The luxury of taking your time
stays.lead: Explore the Loire, Cher and Sologne while keeping the house as your retreat.
steps: Space castle visits between village, vineyard and garden days.
Enjoy the river, Beauval Zoo and seasonal swimming.
Follow cycling and walking routes while preserving time for meals and the garden.
stays.imageAlt: Cyclists on a quiet Loire road

stays.title: Live in the Loire Valley for a while
stays.lead: Settle into a happy routine of markets, vineyards, walks and discoveries.
steps: Make room for major sights and the landscapes between them.
Travel towards the Cher Valley, villages and Sologne forests.
Let the days without an objective become your best memories.
stays.imageAlt: Vineyards and path in the Loire Valley

empty.title: Broaden your duration or mood to discover more suggestions.
